sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently 1st with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00 in what should be a routine fixture against the bottom-of-the-table visitors. The league leaders then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October at 15:00; both opponents are struggling near the foot of the table, offering Sandbach chances to extend their lead despite their most recent outing ending in defeat.
